title: CEO Jensen Huang On the Future of Nvidia

author: CNET
description:
In a Q&A on March 17, Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang addressed internet critiques from gamers on DLSS 5, calling them "completely wrong." Huang underlined that DLSS 5 "enhances and adds generative capability, but it doesn't change the artistic control" and that "it's in the direct control of the game developer."

Read more: https://www.cnet.com/tech/gaming/nvidia-teases-dlss-5-gamers-arent-impressed/
